observations: The repaired path produced actual Root, Candidate Evaluate, Execute, Task Evaluate, and consolidation progress under the original generation and fence.
The guard was discriminating on the checked paths: missing/state-only evidence failed with no mutation, while exact causal evidence passed.
Existing Candidates were inapplicable; no activation, split, merge, supersede, or new Candidate is supported by this single episode.
Publication remains the immediate continuation and is not a completion condition.
fragment.purpose: Learn from the generation-22 causal stop repair and recovery-audit episode.

coverage of future previously unseen discretionary-stop wordings

result.applicability: Apply this learning at Work resume boundaries when durable prior termination or refire evidence signals approval, permission, or discretionary stopping. Do not apply it to a fresh valid writer, a hard platform prohibition, or a running exact-head workflow.
costs_and_risks: The preflight adds one bounded state/policy read and exact digest validation before resume.
Signal matching may not classify every future wording; ambiguous cases must remain fail-closed and be added only with evidence.
Timestamped connector receipts improve provenance but do not prove linearizable latest remote state.
result.reason: The revision-28 continuity preflight and the bounded recovery-audit adapter already cover the observed failure class without overlapping an existing Candidate. One checked recovery episode does not support a broader prompt, evaluator, runner, or Candidate-policy change.
retained_learning: Discretionary-stop repair must address both the decision mechanism that reinterpreted authority and the execution entrypoint that allowed an unremediated resume.
A status, heartbeat, or lease mutation is not causal repair; the guard must fail before native mutation and bind positive authorization to exact execution and policy identity.
Recovery audit provenance must start from current remote main and immutable invocation receipts; unavailable local candidates cannot be reconstructed from memory.
Unit PASS, publication success, broader recovery reliability, and user-level completion are distinct claims.
result.rollback: If the causal preflight rejects valid non-discretionary recovery, retain the rejection as evidence, repair the classifier with a falsifiable exact-scope test, and preserve native request immutability; do not bypass the guard.
